title: skills: the published `@objectstack/skills` README and two `skills/**` pages still print `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@…"` as the only install line, which exits 1 in a pnpm-installed project (#24926's governed and published rows)
body:
**Filing gate ①: a documented command that fails, measured, with named locations.** `finding` class a. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat. `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H), and `packages/skills` is the package that publishes it; triage re-routes if the lane table says otherwise. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023). These are the rows of #24926 that its `domain:devx` PR #24973 does not touch. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (PR #24973's dev, Node 22.22.0, each scaffold in its own empty directory)

| manager | scaffold | command | exit | wrote |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| pnpm 10.28.0 | pnpm-installed `create-objectstack@18.0.0` | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` | **1**, `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` | nothing |
| pnpm 10.28.0 | the same | `pnpm add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` | 0 | `"18.0.0"` |
| npm 10.9.4 | npm-installed `create-objectstack@18.0.0` | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` | 0 | `"^18.0.0"` |
| yarn 1.22.22 | yarn-installed `create-objectstack@18.0.0` | `yarn add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` | 0 | `"18.0.0"` |

`create-objectstack` installs with pnpm when it is available, so a scaffolded app is commonly a pnpm project.

## The sites (`main`)

| path | note |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/skills/README.md` (≈`:28`) | in the package's `files[]`: this is the npm package page and the tarball text. It owes a patch changeset for `@objectstack/skills` |
| `skills/README.md` (≈`:11`) | governed |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` (≈`:129`) | governed; the upgrade skill an agent follows for this exact move |

The `content/docs/**` rows of #24926 are fixed by PR #24973, and `content/docs/releases/v18/**` by PR #24922. Those PRs give the precedent: the pnpm line in the block, a one-line comment giving npm and yarn, and the rule "add the package with the manager that installed the project".

## Wanted

- Each site gives the install line for the project's own package manager, in the same shape as the docs.
- Where a site prints `npx skills remove --all`, it puts `npx skills list` before it, as the docs now do.
- ⛔ No new gate.

## Dedupe
